responsibility: This file implements the persistent recording-side IR used by libgccjit before compilation. It provides dump-file support, C source reconstruction for recorded API activity, context-owned allocation helpers, and the replay/write/debug behavior of many recording::memento subclasses such as statements, extended asm, asm goto, and top-level asm. Its responsibility is to capture API calls as a reusable object graph, serialize or pretty-print that graph for debugging, and define how recorded objects replay themselves into the playback layer.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-recording.h, which defines the recording-side class hierarchy and APIs, this same-stem .c file provides their concrete behavior: building and dumping the recorded memento graph, emitting C source that replays recorded API use, and implementing how recorded statements, asm forms, and other objects replay into the playback layer.
